summary: Georgia lookout list places an Aultman Still tower in Worth County at 302 ft; no source found describes the tower, its history or the site today.

evidence.supports: Aultman Still tower listed in Worth County at 31.75285, -83.89004, 302 ft, with codes BLL-41134, usgs and gfc-216
Directory lists an Aultman Still tower in Worth County with no other detail
The list's map was revised on 22 March 2016

notes_for_editor: Thin record: a tower-list row (coordinates, elevation, county, codes) and a name-only directory entry. Neither gives a build date, design, staffing, or whether the tower stands, so the story has no built, staffing or fate section and the status stays unknown. Two searches found nothing on a tower by this name or on the name itself. A Wikimedia Commons photo (File:Georgia_Forestry_Commission,_Worth_County_tower.JPG, dated 2015) shows a Georgia Forestry Commission tower at 128 Fire Tower Rd, Sylvester, described as north of the city limits. It is not identified as Aultman Still and its location is about 24 km south of the Aultman coordinates, so it was not used as a photo or as a source. Register codes now follow the list's format (BLL-41134, usgs, gfc-216). The earlier 'registers' correction was dropped because a format preference is not an error in the record (STORY_GUIDE). The list gives elevations as bare numbers with no unit; feet is inferred from the values, as in the house style.
